title: Low-dose Dual-energy CT for the Pre-surgical Planning of Patients With Progression of Scoliosis
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of low-dose dual energy CT in the pre-surgical planning of patients with progression of scoliosis
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with progression of scoliosis without vertebral arthrodesis
* patients able to maintain immobility for the duration of the exam
* patients from 5 to 20 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* vertebral arthrodesis
* patients unable to maintain immobility for the duration of the exam
* non-compliant patients
* obese patients
* patients younger than 5 years old or older than 20 years old
study_population: Patients with progression of scoliosis selected at the Rizzoli Orthopaedic Institute
